author: feral-core
description: Read, search, draft, and send email. Backed by Gmail when the user is signed in via Google OAuth; falls back to IMAP/SMTP when the user has configured a generic mail provider. Read endpoints are safe; sending is a confirm-tier action.

endpoints.description: List the most recent emails in the inbox. Read-only.

params.name: max_results
params.description: Number of messages to fetch (default 20, max 100)

endpoints.description: Fetch the full body and metadata of one email by its message id.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Provider message id from list_inbox / search

endpoints.returns_description: {id, from, to, subject, body, html, date, headers}

endpoints.description: Search the user's mailbox. With Google OAuth, uses the Gmail API ``q`` syntax (from:, subject:, after:, before:, has:attachment, label:, etc.). With App Password / generic IMAP, Gmail hosts use the IMAP ``X-GM-RAW`` extension with the same Gmail syntax in ``query``; other IMAP hosts use RFC3501 SEARCH built from the structured params (``from_``, ``subject``, ``since``, ``before``, ``body``). Prefer ``query`` for Gmail-style free text; use structured params when you need portable IMAP filters.

params.name: query
params.description: Primary free-text search. Gmail syntax when OAuth or Gmail App Password IMAP (from:, subject:, after:YYYY/MM/DD, has:attachment, label:, etc.). On generic IMAP, maps to TEXT when no structured params are set.

params.name: from_
params.description: Sender filter. Gmail: composed into query; generic IMAP: FROM criterion.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject filter. Gmail: subject:…; generic IMAP: SUBJECT criterion.

params.name: since
params.description: Messages on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD). Gmail: after:…; generic IMAP: SINCE.

params.name: before
params.description: Messages before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD). Gmail: before:…; generic IMAP: BEFORE.

params.name: body
params.description: Body keyword. Gmail: appended to query; generic IMAP: TEXT criterion.

params.name: folder
params.description: IMAP mailbox to search (default INBOX). Examples: [Gmail]/All Mail, [Gmail]/Sent Mail. Ignored on Gmail OAuth API path.

params.name: has_attachment
params.description: When true, restrict to messages with attachments (Gmail has:attachment; generic IMAP has no native filter).

endpoints.returns_description: {messages: [{id, thread_id?, from, subject, date, snippet, has_attachments?}], source: 'gmail' | 'imap', query_used: string, next_page_token?: string}

endpoints.description: Send an email from the user's account. Always requires explicit operator confirmation — outbound mail is an irreversible action.
Create a draft email without sending it. Drafts are stored on the provider and visible in the user's drafts folder.
Return the number of unread messages in the inbox.
Summarize the most recent unread/incoming emails using the configured LLM. Read-only.

params.name: max_emails
params.description: Max emails to include in the summary (default 10)
